SECRET_KEY.description: Long random secret used to sign Flask admin sessions.

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: The single email address allowed to access /admin/.

ADMIN_EMAIL_FROM.description: Verified Brevo sender used for admin login codes.

BREVO_API_KEY.description: Brevo API key used to send passwordless admin login codes. Keep private.

DATABASE_URL.description: Optional Postgres connection URL for persistent admin login codes, activity tracking, and CMS content.

GOOGLE_ADS_CONVERSION_ID.description: Public Google Ads conversion ID used by the Google tag.

GOOGLE_ADS_CONVERSION_ACTIONS_JSON.description: Optional JSON map from first-party analytics events to Google Ads conversion labels.

CMS_DATA_PATH.description: Optional local development JSON path for CMS content when DATABASE_URL is unavailable.

CMS_LOCAL_UPLOAD_ROOT.description: Optional local development upload root. Do not rely on local uploads for Heroku persistence.

MAILCHIMP_API_KEY.description: Mailchimp API key for newsletter subscriptions. Leave unset until ready.

MAILCHIMP_AUDIENCE_ID.description: Mailchimp audience/list ID for newsletter subscriptions.

MAILCHIMP_SERVER_PREFIX.description: Mailchimp server prefix, such as us21. Optional if included in the API key suffix.

MAILCHIMP_TAGS.description: Comma-separated tags applied to new Mailchimp subscribers.

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Cloudflare Turnstile public site key for newsletter bot protection.

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: Cloudflare Turnstile secret key for server-side verification. Keep private.
